Name: Friendship Streaks
Author: AvalonMFX
Description:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/41Tda8I.png[/img]

     You have an individual streak for each NPC

[list]
[*]After talking to an NPC, the current talking streak will be incremented by 1﻿
[*]After giving a gift to an NPC, the current gift streak will be incremented by 1
[*]The [u]talking streak will reset[/u] if you haven't talked to the NPC the [u]previous day[/u]
[*]The [u]gift streak will reset[/u] if you haven't given atleast a single gift to the NPC the [u]previous week[/u]
[/list]
[size=2]In conclusion, it tracks the talking and gifting streak with each NPC without missing a day/weak.[/size]

Your [b]current streaks[/b] can be viewed when opening the Social Menu

[img]https://i.imgur.com/yC2n9TT.png[/img]


Your[b] highest streaks[/b] including the bonus can be viewed when selecing the desired character in the menu

[img]https://i.imgur.com/oHGFuyX.png[/img]﻿


The [b]multiplier is optional[/b] and applies a little bonus to your friendship gain. The higher the streak, the higher the bonus. Here's the formula that will calculate your bonus:

[code]bonus (in %) = 0.2 * CurrentTalkingStreak + 0.35 * CurrentGiftGivingStreak
[/code][font=Courier New][color=#999999]
[/color][/font]If you didn't miss a single day with gifts and talking, you can earn a bonus of 8.4% each season!  
This means, you will get 8.4% more points for each action resulting in building a better relationship in a shorter time span.

[color=#cccccc][size=4](If you don't like that feature, feel free to disable it in the config)[/size][/color]

[size=4][img]https://i.imgur.com/W1gSYfd.png[/img][/size]

[list]
[*][color=#6aa84f][b]Multiplayer compatible[/b][b]:[/b][/color][color=#f4f4f4] All players will have individual streaks. Additionally, if your friends are playing while you're not, your streaks won't be reset.[/color]
[*][b][color=#6aa84f]Compatible with modded NPCs:[/color][/b][color=#f4f4f4] Any modded NPC will receive a streak.[/color]
[*][b][color=#f1c232]MacOS compatible:[/color][/b] [u]Unknown[/u][color=#f4f4f4]. I don't own any macOS device in order to test it. If you're running this mod on a Mac computer, please tell me about your experience by leaving a comment.[/color]
[*][b][color=#6aa84f]Generic Mod Config Menu:[/color][/b][color=#f4f4f4] The config of this mod can be modified using [/color][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿
[/list]

[/color]
